subject: general
question: In October 2025, the Delhi government in collaboration with the Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur, implemented which of the following techniques to combat air pollution?

options.text: Cloud seeding to induce rainfall and reduce air pollution
Using fog cannons to disperse smog particles in polluted areas
Launching aerial drones to monitor and neutralise toxic gases
Installing large-scale vertical gardens across industrial zones

solution:
The correct answer is __**Cloud seeding to induce rainfall and reduce air pollution**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Delhi government**, in a strategic collaboration with the **Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Kanpur**, implemented **cloud seeding** technology in **October 2025** to mitigate the severe **air pollution** crisis in the **National Capital Region (NCR)**.
 
• **Cloud seeding** is a weather modification technique designed to induce **artificial rain** by dispersing substances into the air that serve as cloud condensation or ice nuclei.
 
• This initiative was specifically aimed at reducing the concentration of hazardous pollutants, including **PM2.5** and **PM10**, which typically spike during the onset of **winter** due to **stubble burning** and **temperature inversion**.
